articles.author: Linus Höller
articles.title: Report: CIA warned Europe of Russian drone attack from vessels in the Mediterranean - Defense News
articles.description: The CIA reportedly warned European nations of a suspected Russian plot to launch explosive drones from aboard commercial vessels in the Mediterranean.
articles.content:
VIENNA The CIA has warned European countries of a suspected Russian plot to launch Gerbera-type drones from aboard commercial vessels in the Mediterranean, a new report says.
